Substitute only gid in the relay ForwardedRequest passed to policyEnf while keeping Alice's verified credential records. Paper profiles use no decision certificate. The DBC may authorize the substituted tuple; the grant gid is relay-asserted. With D35/A38 the symbolic response follows that gid's PBC-registered recipient key, not the original requester. An unregistered gid gets no release. This is a reconstruction/specification-gap comparison, not an HMBC exploit.

Forward both BEFORE ONE checkpoint covering both. Collect BOTH honest policy-aware ALLOW certificates BEFORE either consume; each sees nonceConsumed=false.
